posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
I'm trying to figure out why I thought Jagged Earth was the end of Spirit Island expansions. Maybe it was the full doubling in number of spirits, or maybe the add-on of the box insert to hold everything. (Now I'm glad I didn't get that insert!) I would certainly be happy if Spirit Island was done, given the sheer size and number of gameplay options of the game at this point, but it's also exciting to hear that it's got some more content plotted out ahead of it. Rabit's question was a good one to come after mine.

But seriously, the current expansions are the representative sizes for future Spirit Island expansions? So, the multiple planned expansions for a game that's already Scythe-sized will be either "huge" or "ginormous?" Adam's not the only one with a ton more art to draw!
